description: This file provides API utility functions for interacting with a backend service, including HTTP methods (GET, POST, PATCH, DELETE), comment handling, work item management, and URL construction, with integrated authorization headers and localStorage-based user info extraction.

methods.name: withAuthHeaders(extra = {})
methods.description: Builds headers object with Authorization if token available

methods.name: apiDelete(path)
methods.description: Sends a DELETE request to backend and returns parsed JSON or throws error on failure.

methods.name: apiPost(path, body)
methods.description: Sends a JSON POST request to backend and returns parsed JSON or throws error.

methods.name: apiGet(path, params)
methods.description: Sends a GET request with optional query parameters, handling URL encoding.

methods.name: apiPatch(path, body)
methods.description: Sends a JSON PATCH request to backend and returns parsed JSON.

methods.name: getWorkItemComments({ project_id, id })
methods.description: Fetches comments for a specific work item.

methods.name: addWorkItemComment({ project_id, id, body, author_id = null, author_display_name = null })
methods.description: Adds a new comment to a work item, sourcing author ID from localStorage.

methods.name: getWorkItems({ projectId } = {})
methods.description: Fetches work items, optionally filtered by projectId.

methods.name: createWorkItem({ project_id, item_type, title, description, status, priority, created_at })
methods.description: Creates a new work item with additional creator info from localStorage.

methods.name: updateWorkItemStatus({ project_id, id, status })
methods.description: Updates the status of a specific work item.

methods.name: buildUrl(path)
methods.description: Constructs and returns a full URL for an API path.
